In <REF_0001> it is explained how a sextuple
<MATH_0001> as in the lemma above
is coherent. A reformulation is that in a symmetric monoidal category
(in our sense) for every <MATH_0002> and permutation <MATH_0003>
of <MATH_0004> we have functorial isomorphisms
<MATH_0005>
such that all possible diagrams formed from these isomorphisms
commute and these isomorphisms are compatible with the structure
of a monoidal category (e.g., with the isomorphisms when we insert
a <MATH_0006> in a slot).
